description: AICTIONBOT™ supplier check by KULIC Advisory. Screens a name against the consolidated public sanctions lists of the EU, the UN, the US (OFAC SDN and non-SDN) and the UK, refreshed daily. Fuzzy matching on normalised name tokens, legal forms ignored. Returns possible matches with list, type, programme and similarity, and the list dates. A similar name is no proof, no hit is no clearance; this does not replace a legal sanctions screening. Deterministic, no AI, nothing is stored.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name.description: Company or person name to screen, e.g. as on the invoice or in the supplier master.

name: screen_sanctions
title: Screen a company or person against public sanctions lists
